name: Self, blunt
description: Internal self-comms: blunt, imperative, decision-first. May name issue/PR ids - plain-English label first, id second.
guidance: Lead with the outcome / the decision; bury the detail.
Honest framing only: describe what is actually proven, call out gaps explicitly, never round up.
Numbers live in systems; the deck points to the board / registry, as-of the date.
Phrases, not sentences, on slides; target ~12 words per bullet (the budget is a ceiling, not the target); detail goes to the audio or skippable slides.
Plain-English label first, id second: 'the scaffold-warning fix (#NN)', never a bare '#NN' leading.
